name: razgon-glow-studio
description: Voiceover → soft-lit 2.5D 'What if…?' video: big round black heads with white oval eyes, muted hoodies with drawstrings, thin stick legs and a warm edge light; night porches, office kitchens, sunset farm stands, dusk parks, monitor-lit rooms; invisible outline people, orange percentage pills, navy study cards, handwritten signs, soft bloom and depth of field. Successor of Razgon 2D Studio (same pipeline: Whisper timestamps, director pass, music + SFX), five Glow styles, Cyrillic text, 16:9 or 9:16 up to 4K.
